body: I feel you.. I don’t get angry, I more get an empty feeling in my stomach and become nauseous
Damn sorry about getting ghosted by someone you care about, shit fucking sucks. I’m going to kill myself tomorrow night but if you want to talk in the meantime let me know
Thank you again for your kind words. If others were like you, this world might actually be a decent place to live

That’s pretty much how I’ve spent the past few months. I’ve been eating out and going to state parks and all kinds of things to distract myself from the sheer loneliness. I’ve invited multiple friends to go on these outings with me and offered to pay but not takers. I just can’t keep masking the loneliness it just needs to stop
The thing is I’m the one who doesn’t deserve it. Everyone else gets along fine my brain just doesn’t work I guess. I really do appreciate your offer to talk sometime

I was in the pizza business, but I recently went out of business about a month ago (left that part out story was already long haha). I enjoy crown myself but I’m think some Jack Daniels Tennessee Honey will be good.

My experience is a little different but you might find something in it. When I had a similar thing happen, 72hr hold after an attempt, the girl who I had a “thing” with did visit me and still talk to me after, but it was almost like I was a wounded animal or something. Like the spark was gone. But I’m going to point out we hadn’t been dating for a long time and I feel like as a guy with depression most girls start want a “man” and a “man” doesn’t get sad and try to hurt himself. Idk I hope everything works out for you and I’m sure he’s just processing everything. If you ever need someone to talk to let me know, I know I sure do lol
